Invented registration page

You are a small operator if your total sales over four consecutive calendar quarters are $40,000 or less.

Once you pass that amount, you have to register by the day after the month in which you passed it.

The agency calls this the “operator test” — it’s applied each quarter.

Rates are set out in the IA/IR schedule…

Café owners and food‑truck operators follow the same rule.
